posts.content:
🚨 We're hiring: Investment Analyst – Dubai, UAE

💼 Role: Investment Analyst
📍 Location: Dubai, UAE
💰 Salary: AED 9,500 to 12,500 per month
🎓 Experience: 2+ years
⏰ Last date to apply: 11 December 2026

📝 Hiring now: an Investment Analyst in Dubai, UAE. If you are organised and reliable, this role is for you.

📌 What you will do:
• Analyse financial and commercial information
• Monitor portfolio and transaction updates
• Support due diligence activities
• Research investment opportunities and markets
• Follow company policies and procedures

🎓 What we are looking for:
• 2+ years of relevant experience
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Business (CA, CMA, ACCA or CPA is a plus)
• Good knowledge of financial analysis
• Practical understanding of valuation fundamentals
• Good time management
• Team player with a positive attitude
• Fluent English communication

🌟 A stable, long-term opportunity.

📧 Interested? Send your CV to job@financeinme.com.

♻️ Know someone who would be a great fit? Please repost to help them see it.

Please never pay money to get a job.

#Hiring #InvestmentAnalyst #UAEJobs #FinanceJobs #AccountingJobs
